description: Change docs settings. No draft: live on the docs site on save. Each of theme, seo and socials is a partial object with the keys octri_get_docs_settings shows (e.g. theme { primaryColor: "#ff6a00", colorScheme: "dark", codeTheme: "nord" }); keys left out are unchanged. A socials platform set to "" is removed, and socials.custom replaces the whole list of { label, url, icon }. Returns the saved settings and any theme or seo keys the API ignored as unknown.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional, falls back to the CLI's selected project.

name: octri_set_docs_settings
